    end

    # Lexicographic ordering:

    # 2. Maximum possible pair-span (l_d - e_p) ascending: tightest pair schedules first
    # 3. Earliest delivery deadline (l_d) ascending: urgent deliveries first
    # 4. Earliest pickup time (e_p) ascending: standard arrival priority
    # 5. Deterministic tie-breaker using original pickup ID
    sorted_structs = sort(structs, by = s -> (

        s.span,
        s.l_d,
        s.e_p,

                        sorted_structs[j].span == sorted_structs[i].span &&

        end

            final_indices[i + k - 1] = block[k].pid
        end
        i = j
    end

    return final_indices
end

        end
        if ep_val > max_ep
            max_ep = ep_val
        end
    end

    ep_range = max_ep - min_ep
    if ep_range < 1e-6
        ep_range = 1.0
    end

    best_init_score = Inf
    first_idx = 1
    for k in 1:n
        norm_ep = (ep[k] - min_ep) / ep_range
        score = norm_ep + rand(params.rng) * 0.40
        if score < best_init_score
            best_init_score = score
            first_idx = k
        end
    end

    visited = fill(false, n)

    res[1] = Int64(inst.V_p[first_idx])
    visited[first_idx] = true
    curr = first_idx

    beta = 0.20 + rand(params.rng) * 1.50
    alpha = 0.15 + rand(params.rng) * 0.35

                temp_d = abs(ep[k] - ep[curr])
                c = spat_d + beta * temp_d
                if c < min_c
                    min_c = c
                end
                if c > max_c
                    max_c = c
                end
            end
        end

        cutoff = min_c + alpha * (max_c - min_c)
        n_cand = 0

            end
        end

        chosen_pos = rand(params.rng, 1:n_cand)
        next_idx = candidates[chosen_pos]

    ed = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    ld = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    serv_p = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    trip_dist = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    eff_lp = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        px[k] = Float64(jp.point.x)
        py[k] = Float64(jp.point.y)
        pz[k] = Float64(jp.point.z)

        dy[k] = Float64(jd.point.y)
        dz[k] = Float64(jd.point.z)

        lp[k] = Float64(inst.l[p])
        ed[k] = Float64(inst.e[d])
        ld[k] = Float64(inst.l[d])
        serv_p[k] = Float64(jp.servt)

        dist_x = px[k] - dx[k]
        dist_y = py[k] - dy[k]
        dist_z = abs(pz[k] - dz[k])
        trip_dist[k] = sqrt(dist_x * dist_x + dist_y * dist_y) + 500.0 * dist_z
        eff_lp[k] = min(lp[k], ld[k] - trip_dist[k] - serv_p[k])
    end

    visited = fill(false, n)
    res = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)

    # Pick starting request probabilistically from early requests
    start_scores = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    min_s = Inf
    max_s = -Inf
    for k in 1:n
        s = ep[k] + 0.2 * eff_lp[k]
        start_scores[k] = s
        if s < min_s; min_s = s; end
        if s > max_s; max_s = s; end
    end

    s_thresh = min_s + 0.30 * (max_s - min_s)
    initial_candidates = Int64[]
    for k in 1:n
        if start_scores[k] <= s_thresh
            push!(initial_candidates, k)
        end
    end

    if isempty(initial_candidates)
        curr = 1
    else
        curr = initial_candidates[rand(params.rng, 1:length(initial_candidates))]
    end

    visited[curr] = true
    res[1] = Int64(inst.V_p[curr])

    # Sequentially chain spatially and temporally compatible requests via GRASP RCL
    for step in 2:n
        cur_x = dx[curr]
        cur_y = dy[curr]
        cur_z = dz[curr]
        cur_t = ep[curr]

                slack = eff_lp[j] - ep[j]

                c_j = sp + 1.0 * dt + 0.1 * slack
                costs[j] = c_j

                if c_j < min_c; min_c = c_j; end
                if c_j > max_c; max_c = c_j; end
            end

        for j in 1:n

            end
        end

        if isempty(rcl)
            for j in 1:n
                if !visited[j]
                    push!(rcl, j)
                end
            end
        end

        curr = rcl[rand(params.rng, 1:length(rcl))]
        visited[curr] = true
        res[step] = Int64(inst.V_p[curr])
    end

    return res

            lateness_risk = max(0.0, arr_time - lp)

            pair_slack = ld - ep
            noise = (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 5.0

            score = arr_time + 0.5 * spatial_dist + 2.0 * time_wait + 5.0 * lateness_risk + 0.1 * pair_slack + noise

            if score < best_cand_score

                best_cand = k
            end
        end

        if best_cand == -1

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n

        return copy(inst.V_p)
    end

    min_e = Float64(inst.e[inst.V_p[1]])

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
        lp = Float64(inst.l[p])
        if ep < min_e; min_e = ep; end
        if lp > max_l; max_l = lp; end
    end
    time_span = max(max_l - min_e, 1.0)

    keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64, Int64}}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
        ld = Float64(inst.l[d])

        zp = Float64(jp.point.z)
        pair_slack = ld - ep

        cx = Float64(jp.point.x)
        cy = Float64(jp.point.y)
        angle = atan(cy, cx)

        noise_time = (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * (0.05 * time_span)
        noise_slack = (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * (0.05 * time_span)

        keys[k] = (zp, ep + noise_time, pair_slack + noise_slack, angle, k)
    end

    sort!(keys, by = x -> (x[1], x[2], x[3], x[4]))

    res = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        res[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[keys[k][5]])
    end

    return res

    start_t = max(Float64(inst.e[curr_p]), 0.0) + Float64(jp.servt) + dist_pd + Float64(jd.servt)
    curr_time = max(start_t, Float64(inst.e[curr_d]))

            score = arrival_p + 0.8 * wait_p + 10.0 * late_p + 0.1 * dist_to_p - 0.05 * pair_slack + (rand(params.rng) - 0.5) * 30.0

            if score < best_score

        curr_x = dk_x
        curr_y = dk_y
        curr_z = dk_z
    end

    return res

function llm_candidate_score(inst::InstanceData, params::ParameterData)::Vector{Int64}
    n = inst.n
    if n == 0
        return Int64[]
    end
    if n == 1
        return copy(inst.V_p)
    end

    ep_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    ld_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    z_vec = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    tightness_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    dist_vec = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)

    for k in 1:n
        p = inst.V_p[k]
        d = inst.V_d[k]

        jp = inst.jobs[p]
        jd = inst.jobs[d]

        ep = Float64(inst.e[p])
        ld = Float64(inst.l[d])

        ep_vec[k] = ep
        ld_vec[k] = ld
        z_vec[k] = Int64(jp.point.z)
        tightness_vec[k] = ld - ep

        dx = Float64(jp.point.x - jd.point.x)
        dy = Float64(jp.point.y - jd.point.y)
        dist_vec[k] = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
    end

    island_min_ep = Vector{Float64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        min_ep = ep_vec[k]
        zk = z_vec[k]
        for m in 1:n
            if z_vec[m] == zk && ep_vec[m] < min_ep
                min_ep = ep_vec[m]
            end
        end
        island_min_ep[k] = min_ep
    end

    keys = Vector{Tuple{Float64, Int64, Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64, Float64}}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        noise = rand(params.rng) * 0.01
        keys[k] = (island_min_ep[k], z_vec[k], ep_vec[k], tightness_vec[k], ld_vec[k], dist_vec[k], noise)
    end

    p_indices = sortperm(keys)

    res = Vector{Int64}(undef, n)
    for k in 1:n
        res[k] = Int64(inst.V_p[p_indices[k]])
    end
    return res
